Container.Name: maldet-scanner
Container.Overview: Linux Malware Detect (maldet) + ClamAV scanner for Unraid. Uses ClamAV engine without the RAM-hungry daemon. Zero memory usage between scans. Supports Telegram alerts. Modes: - scan: Run a full scan and exit (default, use with User Scripts scheduler) - monitor: Watch for new/modified files via inotify (runs continuously) - update: Update signatures only

Config.Name: Scan Target
Config.Description: Path to scan for malware. Mounted read-only for safety.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for virus signatures, quarantine, and logs.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: scan = full scan then exit | monitor = watch files continuously | update = update signatures only

Config.Name: Telegram Alerts
Config.Description: Enable Telegram notifications for scan results.

Config.Name: Telegram Chat ID
Config.Description: Your Telegram chat or group ID.

Config.Name: Quarantine
Config.Description: Copy infected files to quarantine directory.

Config.Name: Scan Excludes
Config.Description: Pipe-separated list of directories to exclude. Example: /scan/Media|/scan/appdata/PlexMediaServer
